messages:
alex: Heads up — after landing kernel-selector v2.3 and enabling INT8 slot compaction on canary, we see a latency bump and a small accuracy regression on long-context evals (L=64k). Repro'd on prod-canary.
perf-bot: Alert: +18% p95 latency, +0.6% absolute eval loss on longctx-suite since 2026-03-17 14:02 UTC. Telemetry attached below.
Priya: can you paste the canary config + the exact commit?
alex: commit: 3f9d2b7 (kernel-selector v2.3). Canary cfg snippet: ```json
{"kv_compaction":"int8_slot","eviction_policy":"lru","prefetch_slots":false,"kernel_override":null}
```
Sam: quick thought — int8 slots are smaller but more fragmented. If compaction changed alignment we might be causing more page churn when sequences go long. Page bounce -> eviction thrash.
Megan: also saw kernel fallback noise in logs: KernelPicker selected int8_fast, then fell back to bf16_matmul on some steps (lots of small tensors). That causes extra memcpy and temp buffer allocation which can spike latency.
alex: logs show a repeated pattern: slot_alloc -> immediate evict -> re-prefetch ~3s later. KV residency for longctx queries drops rapidly.
perf-bot: Profiling dump (summary):
```
# perf summary
pages/sec: canary=420 (baseline=95)
evictions/sec: canary=210 (baseline=40)
memcpy_ms: +1.6x on avg
kernel-fallback-rate: 12% of steps
cpu-blocking-ms: +9ms p50
```
Priya: ok that matches fragmentation+fallback hypothesis. Can you run a deterministic local repro using longctx generator? Sam do you have a script?
Sam: yep — run: ```./bench_longctx --model gpt-xxl --seq 65536 --int8 --kv-mode=compacted --workload=chatty --log-kernel-picks``` That reproduces page bounce in my laptop sim of slot allocation.
Megan: quick mitigation idea — switch eviction_policy to freq-based (LFU-ish) and enable prefetch_slots for longctx flows. That should reduce re-fetch storms. Also consider forcing kernel_selector to prefer bf16 kernels for small matmuls when int8 fallback rate > 5%.
alex: can we try a soft canary: route only longctx queries to fp16 path but keep int8 for shorter ones?
Priya: yes — route by request header or seq_length. Add runtime flag: `kv.force_fp_for_longctx=true` and `kv.longctx_threshold=32768`.
perf-bot: Telemetry after soft canary (simulated): pages/sec -> 110, evictions/sec -> 45, p95 latency back near baseline, accuracy regression disappears in the sample run.
Sam: sounds promising. I'd still like to understand why compaction changed alignment — maybe slot packing now uses 8-byte stride vs 16 previously for int8, causing more small holes in slab allocator. Need allocator dump.
Megan: I grabbed slabmap diff — compaction now packs slots tightly and does not keep minimal guard gap; that reduces peak memory but increases fragmentation for variable-length KV entries.
alex: action items: 1) rollback soft canary for longctx (route to fp16) 2) run allocator dump & heap profile on canary 3) test LFU+prefetch in staging 4) add kernel_selector threshold for fallback -> prefer bf16 for small matmuls
Priya: I'll own the staging test matrix and will run the LFU/prefetch runs today.
Sam: I'll produce allocator dumps and a microbench to poke slot stride changes.
Megan: I'll submit a small kernel-selector tweak PR to allow exclusion of int8_fast for small-matmul shapes.
alex: thanks. I'll open an issue with the perf traces + link to this thread and tag infra for a temporary revert if we see production impact.
alex: repro command I'm running locally for others: `./bench_longctx --seq 65536 --int8 --kv-compaction=packed --eviction=lru --log-slabs > kv_repro.log`
Priya: pinging @Megan and @Sam if they need infra creds for the allocator dumps.
Megan: got it.
alex: will update here after the staging LFU runs finish (~2h).
